title: Extract text from file (OCR)
description: Reads text and tables from a file produced by an earlier step (such as an email attachment, a Telegram photo or a Drive download), an uploaded file or a file URL. Configure exactly one of artifactId, fileUrl or file.

artifactId.title: Uploaded file
artifactId.description: Identifier of an uploaded file. Use only one of Uploaded file, File URL or File from an earlier step.

fileUrl.title: File URL
fileUrl.description: Address of a file to read. Use only one of Uploaded file, File URL or File from an earlier step.

file.title: File from an earlier step
file.description: A file produced by an earlier step, for example an email attachment: {{ trigger.input.attachments[0] }}, a Telegram photo or document: {{ trigger.input.file }}, or a Google Drive download. Up to 10 MiB. Use only one of Uploaded file, File URL or File from an earlier step.

detectTables.title: Detect tables
detectTables.description: Also detect tables in the document.
